projects.name: Agent HQ
projects.use: Compact board, messages and expiring claims
projects.boundary: General task writes bypass claim and readiness; HTTP actor is unauthenticated.

projects.name: agent-kanban-rs
projects.use: Local transactional claims and reviewer completion
projects.boundary: No project registry, remote authentication or per-attempt identity.

projects.name: Python Agent Mail
projects.use: Threaded messages, receipts and resource reservations
projects.boundary: External task authority required; reservations report conflicts but still grant.

projects.name: Rust Agent Mail
projects.use: Mail events, keyed replay and conflict-filtered file leases
projects.boundary: External task authority required; build slots remain advisory; restricted license.

projects.name: Agent Swarm
projects.use: Lead/worker tasks, dispatch, workflow and recovery
projects.boundary: Manual and automatic readiness, HTTP and MCP completion policies differ.

projects.name: Backlog.md
projects.use: Markdown task context, dependencies, CLI and browser
projects.boundary: Edit locks and assignee strings are not exclusive worker ownership.

projects.name: Beads
projects.use: Task graph, conditional claims and durable claim leases
projects.boundary: Named claims, claim-next, close verbs and generic done patches differ.

projects.name: beads_rust
projects.use: Conditional claims, handoff and local workflow gates
projects.boundary: Generic updates lack universal claim guards; caller identities; restricted license.

projects.name: beads-viewer
projects.use: Graph planning, terminal inspection and static reports
projects.boundary: Suggestions do not reserve work; mutations depend on installed tracker; restricted license.

projects.name: DevBoard
projects.use: Small file tracker and agent tool plugin
projects.boundary: Allocation and ID races, file-write durability and alternate-mutation defects.

projects.name: Gemba
projects.use: Operator board, agent launch and escalation
projects.boundary: Process-local claim check follows spawn; no durable multi-coordinator reservation.

projects.name: GitLab
projects.use: Project work records, code integration and agent sessions
projects.boundary: Issue assignment, workflow turn ownership and merge acceptance are separate; CE/EE limits.

projects.name: Kanboard
projects.use: Shared board, subtasks, automation and JSON-RPC
projects.boundary: Assignment is not a lease; parent closure marks subtasks done.

projects.name: Muster
projects.use: Agent/project boards, claims and versioned documents
projects.boundary: Atomic claim does not fence later edits or terminal lane changes.

projects.name: OpenProject
projects.use: Governed work packages, workflow, journals and sprints
projects.boundary: Edit versions do not lease execution; native MCP is Enterprise gated.

projects.name: Paperclip
projects.use: Agent organization, native run authority and recovery
projects.boundary: Native and legacy guarantees differ; project capacity and accepted-child limits.

projects.name: Plane
projects.use: Workspace/project backlog, cycles, modules and pages
projects.boundary: Multiple assignees and ordinary state edits lack execution-attempt ownership.

projects.name: Plane MCP
projects.use: Structured agent access to upstream Plane operations
projects.boundary: Retrieve/replace assignment does not add atomic claims or upstream authority.

projects.name: Planka
projects.use: Shared cards, checklists, notifications and live views
projects.boundary: Card membership is not exclusive ownership; restricted Community license.

projects.name: Rhizome MCP
projects.use: Attempt credentials, checkpoints and frozen completion gates
projects.boundary: Trusted local authority; HTTP loopback; no authenticated remote project management.

projects.name: Taiga backend
projects.use: Stories, tasks, iterations, history and discussion
projects.boundary: Versioned edits and child-status aggregation do not accept child execution results.

projects.name: Taiga frontend
projects.use: Human backlog, board, sprint and detail views
projects.boundary: Backend owns work; reconnect and failed-move reconciliation have gaps.

projects.name: Task Master
projects.use: Task decomposition, native MCP and local autopilot
projects.boundary: Snapshot selection is not reservation; mixed writers; Commons Clause license.

projects.name: Vibe Kanban
projects.use: Coding sessions, worktrees, delegation and approvals
projects.boundary: Routed project UI is retired at pin; local execution is not shared task ownership.

projects.name: Vikunja
projects.use: Project tasks, bot users, MCP and agent CLI
projects.boundary: Claim is several requests; human-close instructions are not server acceptance gates.
